prompts.pause: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one small game HUD control pictogram for Elsewhere. Style: strictly flat clean vector-like illustration, refined and uncluttered, no pixel art. Only dark navy #262238 silhouette with warm cream #FFF7E9 fill and thin restrained dark navy outline. No buttons, plates, square frames, circular frames, background, labels, letters, words or numbers. Transparent background with genuine alpha. No gradients, shading, bevels, shine, reflections, cast shadows, relief, extrusion, perspective or 3D. Orthographic front view. Crisp consistent contours. Square image, the complete pictogram centered precisely both vertically and horizontally and filling about 72 percent of its width and height; equal transparent margins, nothing clipped. This will be displayed at about 30 pixels, so use a confident readable silhouette. Subject: a pause symbol with exactly two equally sized upright flat bars with very slightly rounded corners and a clear gap. Both bars symmetrical around the image center. A carefully drawn flat game control icon, not embossed.
